BiblicalUsage: Zoth is the ordinary Hebrew word for 'this' — this one, this thing, this that stands before you. Adam cries it out over Eve, 'This is now bone of my bones,' and Moses throws it back at Israel, 'Do ye thus requite the LORD?' It is the word that points at what is right in front of you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'this' matters because faith always deals with what is before us — this wife, this covenant, this God — not with abstractions.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
